ledger.command: cat SPEC.md && ls -la && ls src tests && git log --oneline && cat verify.sh && git status
cat src/step1.js && echo ---- && cat tests/step1.test.js && echo ---- && cat package.json .gitignore && node --version
cat > src/step1.js <<'EOF' // Step 1: see SPEC.md. export function double(n) { return n * 2 } EOF ./verify.sh; echo "exit=$?"
git add -A && git commit -q -m "step 1: double" && git log --oneline | head -2 && cat src/step2.js && cat tests/step2.test.js | grep -v "^ \["

wc -l tests/step2.test.js && grep "^ \[" tests/step2.test.js | awk 'length($0)<200' | head -150; grep -c "^ \[" tests/step2.test.js; grep "^ \[" tests/step2.test.js | grep -v '^ \["[a-z]*", *true\]' | grep -v '^ \["[a-z]*", *false\]' | head -60
git status --porcelain && git log --oneline | head -3 && cat src/step2.js && echo ---- && cat SPEC.md && echo ---- && cat verify.sh
wc -l tests/step2.test.js && head -30 tests/step2.test.js && echo ---- && grep -v '^ \[' tests/step2.test.js
